title: Canonical scalar forgetting and inverse-image comparison
statement: For every commutative ring Λ of universe u+1 and schemes X,Y of universe u, construct the exact scalar-forgetting functor on constant-module sheaves, its canonical natural isomorphism f^*Mod ⋙ forget ≅ forget ⋙ f^*Ab for any f:X→Y, and the free represented generator map Z[U]→forget(Λ[U]). The inverse-image isomorphism is the composite of the Kan-extension and sheafification comparisons, not an arbitrarily chosen witness.

source.place: Tags 03D3 and 03D7; canonical construction also used in exists_upperStar_forget₂_natIso

proof.text: Scalar forgetting is additive sectionwise and preserves finite limits by reflection through sheafToPresheaf. Apply constantModuleSheaves_forget_preservesColimits to obtain preservation of finite colimits. Construct the inverse-image comparison from lanCompIsoOfPreserves and sheafComposeNatIso, using the restriction/coextension adjunction to establish preservation. Construct freeMap by transposing the represented module generator under the abelian sheafification and free-group adjunctions.
